tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog lū hi pa'i bum bskyed mdun bskyed lag mchod dang bcas pa bzhugs/

bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'dir 'khor lo bde mchog gi bum bskyed dang mdun bskyed gnyis phyi rol lag mchod dang bcas pa ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa 'jug pa bde bar dgod pa la/ bdag bskyed sngon du btang nas dang po bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ bum pa phyag len bzhin bsam/ khaṇ+ḍa ro his bsangs swa bhā wa 'am/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ bum pa gnyis yod na/ bum pa rnams stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las baṃ baṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar bo lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan 'gyur/ oṃ ta b+te ta b+te ma hā ta b+te swāhā/ lha'i chu bo gang gā dang bum pa'i chu dbyer med par gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa'i dbus su/ mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo a ā/ zhes pa nas/ aṃ aḥste dbyangs dkar bo bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yas skor dang*/ slar yang a ā nas aṃ aḥste dbyangs dkar bo bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yon skor du rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de'i phyi rol tu dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo ka kha zhes pa nas/ sa ha k+ṣa ste gsal byed dmar bo bzhi bcu ba phrag gcig g.yas skor dang*/ slar yang ka kha nas ha k+ṣa ste gsal byed dmar bo bzhi bcu ba phrag gcig g.yon skor du rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa dka' la dmar ba'i mdangs can la dbyangs so gnyis dang gsal byed brgyad cu gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin du snang ba'i ā li dang zla ba'i kha dog dkar ba'i cha ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ kā li dang zla ba'i kha dog dmar ba'i cha ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i dbus su dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gyi hūṃ yig so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ hūṃ yig las kha dog sna lnga ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba'i rtse mo las 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs rnams thon te/

'gro ba rnams 'khor lo lnga'i go 'phang la bkod pa dang sngon thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa rnams lhan cig spyan drangs te mnyam par sbyor ba sngon du 'gro bas zhu bar gyur te/ hūṃ yig gi nā da la thim pas hūṃ yig lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur ba ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ sarba bī ra nas badz+ra shung+ngho3haṃḥzla ba dbyangs gsal hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las gdan rnams dang lha drug cu rtsa gnyis skad cig gis grub par gyur pa ni/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ de yang*/ bum pa'i nang gi rim pa phyi ma'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du ro'i gdan/ de'i nang du sku'i 'khor lo dkar bo rtsibs brgyad pa'i mu khyud la 'khor lo'i phreng ba dang*/de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar bo rtsibs brgyad pa'i mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng ba dang*/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i mu khyud la rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang*/ de'i lter ba bde chen gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka zhes pa nas/ mi rus kyi thal bas lus thams cad la byugs pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs par nas mi mgo bskam po lnga bcu'i do shal can no/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ nas 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi dpral bar rdo rje'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rnam rgyal bum pa'i mtshan ma lnga'i gnas su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ baṃ las rdo rje baṃ gyis=/ bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo bh+ruṃ=/ aṃ las rin po che aṃ=/ dziṃ las pad+ma dziḥ=/ khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa/

de rnams yongs su gyur pa las shar du dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ de'i 'og gi shar du rnam snang dkar bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lhor rin 'byung ser bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rin po che dang =/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis pad+ma dang =/ byang du don grub ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis ral gri dang =/ las bum gyi nang dang mtshan ma'i gnas su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ de gnyis kyi steng du baṃ baṃ las gri gug baṃ gyis mtshan pa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las dum skyes ma gnyis su gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dmar bo zhag gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyangs kyis bzhugs pa/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar bh+ruṃ dkar bo yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang dkar bo/ zhes sogs mngon rtogs ltar phung khams skye mched kyi lha gsal gdab/ de nas gtso bo'i thugs kar zla gdan la rdor sems kyi ngo bo oṃ ha dkar bo/ zhes pa nas/ dpral bar nyi gdan la tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ pheṃ ye shes pa'i 'khor lo'i lha drug cu rtsa gsum dang mtshan ma'i lha'i ye shes pa rnams dbang gi lha dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la / oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ nas oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ho/ /ye shes pa'i 'khor lo'i lha drug cu rtsa gsum dang mtshan ma'i lha'i ye shes pa rnams rang rang gi dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes pa nas/ dam tshig 'khor lo'i lha rnams la don grub kyis dbu brgyan cing*/ las bum gyi dum skyes ma gnyis la rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa dang*/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de nyid la thim par gyur/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs bskyed nas/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas lha rnams la yab yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod pa'i mjug tu/ las bum la/ gos dkar mo ste me yi khams/ /chos rje dran ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /dum skyes ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod/ dung chos kyi chu la/ oṃ a mṛ ta u da ka hūṃ/ zhes pa nyer gcig gam bdun/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bdun bzlas te/ dung chos kyi chu ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas pa'i rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ lha so so'i bzlas bya'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas bum pa'i chu la thim par gyur bar bsams la/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying bo nye snying brgya rtsa brgyad/ lha gzhan la de ltar ram nyer gcig re'am bdun re/ bum pa'i chu la u da ka brgya rtsa brgyad/ las bum la zhal bzhi ba'i sngags dang dum skyes ma'i sngags bzla zhing*/ thun mong du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhe ṣi ga ta ma ye shrī hūṃ/ ci 'grub de nas/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dang hūṃ lan bdun gyis/ bum pa'i lha la dung chos kyi mchod yon 'bul/ de nas oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod de bum lha la me tog 'bul/ de nas gsang chu gtor te/ ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba rnams ma rdzogs par de srid du bgegs rnams bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig/ ces 'phrin las bcol/ gtor ma 'bul na gzhung ltar byin gyis rlabs nas phul te bstod/

ma grub na'ang yab kyi rkang brgyad dang du ma skyes ma la sngar ltar bstod nas/ bum pa'i lha rnams chags pa chen po'i mes zhu nas byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ mtshan ma'i lha rnams kyang 'od du zhu nas lha rang rang gi phyag mtshan gyi rnam par gyur bar bsam mo// //gnyis pa mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du mchod pa mdun bskyed kyi g.yon nas brtsams te bshams la/ ku sha dgod pa dang*/ sbyang ba dang*/ khrus bya bar 'dod na gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya phyag rgya'i skor rnams kyang ji ltar bya ba gzhan du shes par bya zhing*/ 'dir blo 'dzin sogs la bde ba'i phyir 'don cha tsam gtso bor byas te dgod par bya'o/ /de yang las bum mam nang mchod kyis bsangs te/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ he dkar bo/ ru dmar bo/ ka mthing ka /de gsum gyi don rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i rgyud dang*/ brjod pa dang bral ba dang*/ gang du yang mi gnas pa nyid do/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shung+ngha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shung+ngho3haṃ/ dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa gzung ba dang 'dzin pas stong ba'i stong ba nyid du gyur/ he ru ka zhes pa'i yi ge gsum yongs su gyur ba las/ oṃ dkar bo/ āḥdamar bo/ hūṃ sngon po gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs bar gyur/ de gsum las rim pa bzhin du sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams spros/ 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs su gyur te snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste/ oṃ āḥhūṃ la thim zhing*/ oṃ yang āḥl/ āḥyang hūṃ la rim pa bzhin du thim/ hūṃ gi zhabs kyu u ni ha la/ ha ni ha'i mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ nā da yang je phra je phra la skra'i rtse mo brgya stong gi cha'i tshad tsam du gnas par gyur/ oṃ shū n+ya ta

nas ko3haṃ/ nā da yang mi dmigs pa'i phyir thams cad stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las yam sngon po yongs su gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po/ zhes pa nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i dbus su dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gyi hūṃ yig so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ hūṃ yig kha dog sna lnga ba'i 'od zer nas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ de yang khang ba brtsigs pa'i nas lus thams cad la byugs pa'o/ / dag ba bzhag chog/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs par nas mi mgo bskam po lnga bcu'i do shal can no/ / 'dir gsang gnas byin gyis brlab pa dang snyoms 'jug gi skor mngon rtogs ltar byas na legs par sems yang*/ de ltar mi byed pa mang bas brtag/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma la nas dpral bar rdo rje'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lha rnams kyi dpral bar bh+ruṃ dkar bo nas phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar sngar ltar byas nas/ pheṃ ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa sbyan drangs/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi sa bgegs bskrad/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ar+ghaṃ sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ ye shes ba'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa rang dang gco bo tha mi dad pa'i spyi gtsugs nas zhugs/ snying khar chags pa chen po'i mes zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur nas/ yum gyi pad+ma nas 'phros/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ sogs dang*/ rang rang gi dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ pheṃ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' spyan drangs/ sngar ltar mchod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/

nas don grub kyis dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de nyid la thim par gyur bar bsam/ 'dir bde mchog la bdag mdun 'jug pa tha dad yin kyang bdag mdun tha mi dad du bsgrub pa'i lugs ltar na/ rang nyid gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du bye nas dkyil 'khor gyis phyi rol tu gnas par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ 'on kyang sngags rim du sa ra ha dang dā ri ka bas bde mchog la bdag mdun tha dad du mdzad par bshad de dpyad/ de nas dkyil 'khor mchod pa ni/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūṃ las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par 'gyur bar bsams la/ 'bul ba ni/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag/bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags na/ /bzhes nas bdag la bka' drin stsol/ / so so'i phyag rgya gzhung ltar byas nas/ oṃ āḥhri pra wa ra sad ka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang sngags gzhan rnams sngar bzhin la/ mchod yon dang ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su gzhan gsum pa rim pa bzhin/ zhabs bsil dang*/ pā h+yaṃ/ zhal bsil dang*/ añdza ma ṇaṃ/ bsang gtor dang*/ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ/ zhes pa bcug ste 'bul/ de nas/ ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa'i smin legs gzugs/ /'khri shing gzhon nu bzhin du lus phra zhing*/ /bzhin ras rgyas pas zla ba'i mdzes pa 'phrog/ut+pal sngon po'i mig can mchu sgros dmar/ /spel legs me tog phreng ba 'dzin mdzad ma/ /'dod pa'i bde la chags pa mang sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor ba rnams dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /nyer spyod lha mo'i bde bas mchod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du bdug spos nas zhal zas kyi bar la tshigs bcad dang sngags snga ma bzhin du brjod la/ khyad par ni/ spel legs me tog phreng ba 'dzin mdzad ma/ zhes pa dang*/ puṣ+pe zhes pa'i gnas su rim pa bzhin du/

dri zhim bdug pa'i spos snod 'dzin mdzad ma/ zhes dang*/ dhu pe/ rin chen 'od 'bar snang gsal 'dzin mdzad ma/ / zhes dang*/ dī be/ stong gsum ngad ldang dri mchog 'dzin mdzad ma/ / zhes dang*/ gan+dhe/ ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas 'dzin mdzad ma/ / zhes dang*/ nai wi h+ya zhes pa rnams bcug ste 'bul zhing*/ rol mo la/ yid 'ong rol mo'i cha byad mtha' yas las/ /byung ba'i gdangs snyan mi 'dra du ma can/ /thos pas lus sems gdung ba zhi byed pa/ /sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra yis mchod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra shap+ta pra hīts+tsha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes 'bul/ phul byung gzugs mdzes yid 'phrog rgyan gyis spud/ /lang tsho rab rgyas glu dang gar la mkhas/ /dbang bo drug la rmad byung bde ba ster/ /kun gyi dga' bskyed mchod pa'i lha mo ni/ /pi wang gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga mas/ /gdangs snyan sgra yis rna ba'i dga' ston 'gyed/ /rab 'byams mchod pa'i sprin gyis bdag mchod na/ /dgyes bzhin bzhes te mchog rnams stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra wi ṇaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra baṃ she hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mri taṃ ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mu ra dze hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

pi wang zhes pa nas dga' ston 'gyed ces pa'i tshig rkang gnyis kyi gnas su/ bzhin mdzes 'dzum dang ldem pa'i 'gying bag can/ /snyan pa'i glu len mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur ma/ / zhes bcug nas gzhan snga ma bzhin sbyar te/ oṃ badz+ra hā s+ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gīrti hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin du 'og ma gnyis la'ang sbyar te/ me tog skon bu dri zhim bdug sbos dang*/ /mar me'i sdong bu dri yi dung chos 'dzin/ sngar gyi me tog gi nas dri'i bar gyi phyag rgya bzhi rim pa bzhin byas la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dhū be hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dri med me long sbrang chang snod dang ni/ /sna tshogs gos dang chos kyi 'byung gnas 'dzin/ /oṃ rū ba badz+ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ras badz+ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ spar+sha badz+ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dharmāḥdha tu badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces rig ma bcu drug gi mchod/ rab 'byams zhing na ji snyed gzugs mchis pa/ /yongs su gyur pa las byung lha mo ni/ / bzhin ras 'dzum zhing sku yi mdzes pa ston/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje ma yi mchod pa yis/ /gang shar gzugs kyi snang ba thams cad ni/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje mar ni shar ba'i mthus/ /mi 'gyur bde ba chen po rab stsal te/ bde stong mchog gi ting 'dzin rdzogs par shog/oṃ rū pa badz+ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ gzugs zhes pa'i gnas su/ sgra dri ro reg bya zhes sbyar zhing*/ bzhin ras 'dzum zhing sku yi mdzes pa ston / zhes par / snyan pa'i pi wang brdung zhing glu len ma/ / zhes dang*/ sngags la/ oṃ shap+ta badz+ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin du bzang bo'i dri yis phyogs kun rab 'gengs ma/ /oṃ gan+dhe badz+ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/

oṃ ra sa badz+ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 'jam mnyen reg bya mchog gis yid 'phrog ma/ /oṃ spar+sha badz+ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces 'dod yon lnga 'bul/ dri med gser gyi rtsibs stong 'od 'bar ba/ /rin chen in+d+ra nī la'i tog gis mdzes/ /sna tshogs phra bkod mu tig chun 'phyang gis/ /khor yug brgyan pa'i gdugs kyis mchod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ts+tsha traṃ ga pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ drang zhing ldem pa'i rin chen yu ba ni/ /zla phyed rdo rje rin chen rtse mo can/ /dar lce gsum pa rlung gis bskyod pa na/ /sil sil 'khrol ba'i dril chung sgra sgrog cing*/ /sum khug 'khyog gi 'gying dang rab tu ldan/ /mdzes pa'i srog chags mtshan ma yod med kyi/ /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ rab mdzes ba dan rnams kyis mchod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ke tu pra taṅki pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swāhā/ nam mkha'i rgyan gyur rin thang med pa'i gos/ /sna tshogs dar gyi sham bu g.yo ba can/ /tsan dan sprul gyi snying bo'i dris bsgos pa/ /rab 'byams bla re'i sprin gyis mchod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra bi tā na pra hīts+tsha hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes gdugs rgyal mtshan pa dan bla re rnams 'bul/ 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las legs byas shing*/ /rtsibs stong ldan pa'i dpag tshad lnga brgya ba/ /nyi ma gnyis pa lta bur mkhar 'phags te/ /dpag tshad 'bum lam nyi ma gcig gis gcod/ de'i mthus nam mkha'i lam nas dpung tshogs bzhi/ /gling bzhi lha gnas dang por bgrod byed pa'i/ 'khor lo rin chen phul bas 'gro ba kun/ /chos kyi srid la dbang bsgyur thob par shog/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra rat+na pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ rin chen bai ḍūr+ya yi zur brgyad las/ /spros pa'i 'od kyis dpag tshad brgya yi bar/ /mtshan mo'ang nyin mo bzhin du snang byed cing*/ /tsha bas gdungs tshe 'od kyis bsil ba ster/ /der ni dus min 'chi dang nad rnams sel/ /yid la gang bsams phal cher 'byung 'gyur ba'i/

/nor bu rin chen phul bas 'gro kun gyi/ /chos ldan re ba yid bzhin 'grub par shog / sngags kyi thog mtha' gnyis 'dra ba la/ ma ṇi rat+na/ yid 'od blta na sdug pa'i bud med ni/ /lus dang kha nas dri zhim rab tu 'byung*/ /gang gis reg na bde ba'i mchog ster zhing*/ /gling der bkres skom mya ngan sel bar byed/ /bud med skyon lnga spangs shing yon tan ni/ /rnam pa brgyad dang rab tu ldan gyur pa'i/ /btsun mo rin chen phul bas 'gro ba kun/ /zag med bde ba che la spyod par shog /s+t+ri rat+na/ gzhan la mi 'tshe chos ma yin pa sngangs/ /yang dag tha snyad las la skyo ba med/ /sa yi bdag po'i yid la bsams pa rnams/ /ma smras par yang shes nas sgrub par byed/ /dpung rnams 'gro dang gnas dang ldog pa yi/ /bya ba kun la rab tu mkhas gyur pa'i/ /blon po rin chen phul bas 'gro ba kun/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin skong bar shog /pa ri nā ya ka rat+na/ yan lag bdun gnas gangs kyi ri bo 'dra/ /rang bzhin glang bo stong gi stobs dang ldan/ /nyi ma gcig gis 'dzam gling lan gsum 'khor/ /cang shes skud pa yis kyang dkri bar nus/ /gzhan la mig nong mi 'khrug dal gyis 'gro/ /pha rol sde las rgyal bar byed pa yi/ /glang bo rin chen phul bas 'gro ba kun/ /theg pa mchog gi bzhon pas 'gro bar shog/ga dza rat+na/ me tog ku mu da bzhin rab tu dkar/ /lha yi gtsug brgyan nor bu sogs gyis brgyan/ /mdog dang dbyibs dang bongs tshod phun sum tshogs/ /bsgo na nyin gcig 'dzam gling lan gsum 'khor/ / lus la nad med gzi brjid chen po can/ /yongs su ngal ba med pa'i bzhon pa ni/ /rta mchog rin chen phul bas 'gro ba kun/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs dang ldan par shog /a shwa rat+na/ rdo rje rin chen mthon ka mar gad dang*/ / gser dang dngul dang sbug la sogs pa ni/ /zad pa med pas sa phyogs rab 'gengs pa/ /de yi 'byor pa shin tu brtan pa ste/

/g.yo dang sgyu med gzhan la gnod pa med/ /skye bo thams cad rab tu dga' 'gyur ba'i/ /khyim bdag rin chen phul bas 'gro ba kun/ /gsung rab rin chen mdzod kun 'dzin par shog/ gṛ ha pa ti rat+na/ zhes rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul/ de nas nang mchod ni/ rgyas par na mngon rtogs ltar/ mgron rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ dkar bo zhes pa nas gu h+ya badz+ri ṇi swā hā'i bar dang*/ bsdu na ljags byin kyis brlabs te/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha rnams kyi sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags nas 'bul zhing*/ de man sngar bzhin bya'o/ /de las bsdu na dkyil 'khor gyi lha tsam la phul yang rung*/ mthar mnyes shing tshim ste lha thams cad kyi zhal nas/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gsungs bar bsam/ sngar gtso bo las bye ba yin na/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs te gtso bo dang tha mi dad par gyur/ ces brjod/ gnas gsang byin rlabs sngar byas na ni/ gnas bzhi dang gsang gnas byin gyis brlabs pa'i yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i zhes sogs ltar bya la/ ma byas na yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las nas de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mnyes par gyur/ ces pa'i bar bya dgos so/ /de nas gtso bo yab yum gyi snying bo nye snying dang 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi sngags/ rkang brgyad kyi sngags dang bcas pa brjod de mchod/ bstod pa gzhan nam/ / dpal ldan dngos grub mchog gis rin chen gter/ /gang gi drin gyi bde blag thob 'gyur ba'i/ /sku gsum mngon gyur khyab bdag he ru ka /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhan skyes 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i thugs/ /'ja' tshon ltar bkra sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rigs rnams kun gyi rje/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal/ /nyid byed 'bum gyi mdangs ldan in+d+ra rnyil/

/shin tu dag pa'i ri dbang lta bu'i sku/ /rnam thar bzhi yi zhal ldan nyi ma'i spyan/ khro chags sgeg pa'i nyams kyis mdzes la 'dud/ /rten 'brel dag pa'i phyag gi yal 'dab ngos/ /ye shes me tog mtshan ma rab 'bar yang*/ dngos grub 'bras bu'i g.yur gyi rnam par dud/ /'dod dgu'i dpag bsam mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ khrag gis bgos pa'i gnyis 'thung stod g.yog dang*/ /stag gi pags pa'i sham thams grol ba 'phyang*/ /dus mtshan dang bcas mi bzad bdud kyi mgor/ /g.yas brkyangs zhabs kyis gar mdzad khyod la 'dud/ /in+d+ra ni la'i lhun por thun 'tshams sprin/ /gzhon nu'i 'khyud pa'i rjes 'gro bcom ldan ma/ /rdo rje phag mos rab 'khyud tsum+bha nas/ /rab dgyes bde ba'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtso bo'i zhal bzang 'od kyis bris ba bzhin/ /mkha' 'gro lā ma dung skyes gzugs can ma/ /rgyas pa'i las mdzad mnyam nyid ye shes dngos/ /bde chen 'khor lor bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas dang nye gnas rnam dag rdo rje'i rigs/ /char sprin ltar sngo drag po'i las mdzad pa'i/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i dpa' bo dpa' mor bcas/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo mchod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang 'dun rtog dang*/ /nye ba'i 'dun rtog rnam dag pad+ma'i rigs/ /sa la spyod pa'i dpa' bo yab yum ni/ /rab dmar dbang gi las mdzes rnams la 'dud/ /'du dang nye ba'i 'du ba dur khrod dang*/ /nye ba'i dur khrod dag pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ /dpa' mo'i dbang phyug zhi ba mchog tu dkar/ /sa 'og spyod pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'thung gcod rnam dag ral gri 'dzin pa'i rigs/ /phyogs dang 'tshams na mig zum skye bo'i mgor/ khros pa'i gar mdzad sna tshogs las sgrub pa'i/ /dam tshig 'khor lo'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nye ba'i 'thung gcod rnam dag rdo rje 'dzin/ /bde ba'i mchog gyur lhan skyes gcig bu nyid/ /dam tshig sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyi/

/rten dang brten par shar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dri med dge ba'i tshogs/ /rab tu dkar ba gang zhig thob pa des/ /'gro ba ma lus rdo rje theg pa'i grus/ /dngos grub mchog gi dpal la longs spyod shog /ces pa dang*/ gang gi drin gyis sku gsum go 'phang mchog/skad cig nyid la stsol mdzad sku bzhi'i bdag/dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas rin po che/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad+mor phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab 'byams shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /sgrib bral lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i ngor/ /sdom mdzad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso/ /dpal ldan he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi 'od 'bum gyi rtse dgas rab 'khyud pa'i/ /byu ru'i lhun po'i dbang ltar brjid chags shing*/ /mdzes sdug lang tsho rgyas pa'i 'jo sgeg can/ /rdo rje phag mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal kun yum gyur spyan sogs lha mo bzhi/ /gang 'dul skur bstan rnam bzhi'i las mdzad pa'i/ /rnal 'byor ma gtso mkha' 'gro lā ma sogs/ /bde chen lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang pū l+li ra ma ya la sogs/ /nyer bzhi'i yul dang gnas na rab bzhugs te/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad 'khor lo rnam gsum gyi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal la sogs khro bo'i tshogs/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir drag mo'i skur bstan nas/ /dur khrod brgyad gnas dam tshig 'khor lo yi/ /sgo mtshams lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstod pas tshe rabs kun du yang*/ he ru ka dang rje btsun rnal 'byor mas/ /'bral med dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ /zung 'jug go 'phang myur du thob gyur cig/ ces bstod/ /'dir byin rlabs drug skor bya 'dod na/ dang po ni lha rnams kyi sngags dang thod pa bzhi la yi ge gsum lan bzhi/ gnyis pa ni sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags dang*/ gsum pa ni sgo ma bzhi'i sngags/

bzhi ba ni thog mthar oṃ dang āḥswā hā sbyar ba'i dbyangs/ lnga ba ni thog mthar oṃ dang k+ṣa swā hā sbyar ba'i gsal byed/ drug pa ni yig brgya brjod de byin brlab bya'o/ /de nas spro na bhu ri bas mdzad ba'i/ bdag gi lus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang*/ / zhes pa nas/ 'khor 'das ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal du gyur/ ces pa'i bar gyi rgyun bshags dang*/ de tsam mi nus na/ thog ma med nas 'khor ba na/ / chags sogs rtog pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sdig bgyis mgon po'i spyan snga ru/ / ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yin/ /nyer bsdus 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /bsod nams tshogs ni ma lus la/ /rtag par bdag ni yi rang ngo*/ /rdo rje ye shes thugs chung nas/ /shing dbang drung na bzhugs gyur pa'i/ /'gro la nyer brtse thub dbang rnams/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rdzogs gyur te/ /mgon po dbyings su gshegs bzhed la/ /sems can sdug bsngal bral bar du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs/ /bdag ni thub dbang ma gyur bar/ /sangs rgyas la sogs chos rnams dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs bcas/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor lam la gnas bgyi zhing*/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*/ /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las/ /grol bar bdag gis bsgrub par bgyi/ /bsten sogs dge ba de dag gis/ /rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bdag gyur nas/ /'gro ba yongs su sgrol byed shog/ ces sdig bshags bya/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ / zhes pa'i bar dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ / zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ / ces pa'i bar gyis thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom gzung bya/

de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba la/ 'bul yul mngon rtogs kyi skabs ltar spyan drangs nas 'bul ba'ang rung mod/ 'dir mdun bskyed nyid la 'bul ba'i dbang du byas na/ 'das gtor gzhung bzhin phul te bstod gsol byas pa'i rjes su/ 'jig rten pa la 'bul ba'i tshe spyan 'dren mi 'dren gnyis snang ba las/ mi 'dren na phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong sogs skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa las zhes sogs ltar bya zhing*/ 'di la gshegs gsol mi dgos/ spyan 'dren na/ rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig las 'od 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong dang glu la sogs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du khod pa skad cig gis 'od gsal du nas 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/ yig brgya brjod de/ /oṃ yo ga shung+ngho= haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ'ajig rten pa rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /ces brjod de gshegs/ chos skyong dang gzhi bdag gi gtor ma ni skabs 'di 'am/ dngos grub zhu ba'i mjug tu 'ang rung ngo*/ /de nas dkyil 'khor kyi lha rnams gzugs brnyan bzhin gsal bar dmigs la/ lha thams cad kyi sngags dang*/ khyad par yab yum gnyis kyi rtsa sngags snying bo nye snying go cha'i sngags rnams bzla zhing mthar dngos grub zhi ba'i ched du gsol ba gdab pa ni/

hūm̐ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ /dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma/ /mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro ma/ / kun la bdag ni gsol ba 'debs/ /bde ba che la dgyes pa'i he ru kas/ / bde bas rab myos ma la bsnyen byas nas/ /cho ga bzhin du longs spyad pa yis ni/ /lhan skyes bde ba'i sbyor ba la zhugs so/ /a la la la la ho/ /a i a ar li hoḥ dri med mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /brtse bas gzigs la las kun mdzod/ /bde ba chen pos yid ni rab bskyod pas/ /lus ni kun tu g.yo ba'i gar gyis ni/ /phyag rgya'i pad+mar rol pa'i bde ba ches/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog rnams la mchod par mdzod/ /yid 'ong zhi ba'i nyams kyis gar mdzad pa/ /rab dgyes mgon po khyod dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /bdag gi mdun du bzhugs te byin rlobs la/ /lhan skyes bde chen bdag la stsal du gsol/ /bde chen thar ba'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod/ /bde chen spangs pa'i dka' thub du ma yis/ /tshe gcig grol bar mi bzhed bde chen kyang*/ /chu skyes mchog gi dbus na gnas pa yin/ /'dab gyi dbus su skyes pa'i pad+ma bzhin/ /chags las skyes kyang chags pa'i skyon ma gos/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog pad+ma'i bde ba yis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba myur du grol bar mdzod/ /sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas rnams kyi sprang rtsi'i bcud/ /bung ba'i tshogs kyis kun nas 'thungs pa ltar/ /mtshan nyid drug ldan mtsho skyes rgyas pa yi/ /bcud bcings pa yi ro yis tshim par mdzod/ / ces dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs bya'o/ /de yang 'og ma rnams kyi sho lo ka re'i thog mar/ hūm̐ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ nas kun la bdag ni gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ sho lo ka re rdzogs pa'i mthar/ a la la nas brtse bas gzigs la las kun mdzod/ ces pa'i bar sbyar la gdon par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir yig brgya brjod de bzod gsol byed pa 'am/ yang na smon lam rgyas bsdus ci rigs gdab ba'i mjug tu/

yig brgya ci 'grub bzlas nas thal mo sbyar te/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ / zhes pa nas/ bzod mdzod rigs/ zhes bzod gsol bya/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs khyed rnams la thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes zhes sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba spyi ltar byas nas/ bdag dang 'gro la zhes sogs sam/ 'dir ni gzugs dang zhes sogs kyi mjug tu/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod de bstan bzhugs dang shis brjod rgyas pa'am/ ma grub na bsdus pa 'di bzhin byas kyang shin du'ang rung ste/ de yang gtso bo'i bkra shis gang zhig ma'i 'phror/ bkra shis gang zhig bde chen 'khor lo la gnas pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro lā ma dung skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /bdud rtsi rnam lnga'i bcud kyis gang ba'i thod pa yi/ /bden pa des kyang de ring khyed la bkra shis shog/bkra shis gang zhig sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ /legs par gnas pa'i dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug dang*/ khwa gdong la sogs dam tshig 'khor lo'i lha tshogs kyi/ /bden pa des kyang de ring khyed la bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig ye shes rang bzhin gzhal med khang*/ /pha gu dra ba rin chen tshogs kyis rnam par mdzes/ /rdo rje rwa gur me ri dur khrod dang bcas pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang de ring khyed la bkra shis shog/tshangs dang lha dbang zhes sogs kyang brjod par bya'o/ /shis brjod 'di'i rkang ba tha ma ni dbang chog gi skabs su bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog/ces bsgyur nas 'grub po// //gnyis pa phyi rol lag mchod dang bcas bshad pa la gnyis las/ phyi rol mchod pa ni lag pas mchod pa'i sgo nas dang*/ lag mchod ni lag pa la mchod pa'i sgo nas bzhag par 'dod 'jo las bshad cing*/ dang po phyi rol mchod pa byed tshul dngos ni/ /mdun bskyed la mchod pa yin yang dkyil 'khor sger du sgrub pa ma gtogs/ rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas mchod par gzhung nas mi gsal yang da lta lag len du mdzad pa ltar khyad par 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur la/

thog mar gzhung nas bshad pa'i tshul bkod na/ mngon rtogs rgyas pa bsgom pa'i 'jug yin rang gtso bo yab yum gsal gdab bas chog cing*/ de lta bu min na skyabs sems byas te/ shrī he ru ka / zhes pa nas sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur/ ces pa'i bar dag pa gsum gyis bdag bskyed bsdus pa byas te/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs la/ mtheb srin gyis blangs nas/ oṃ sum bha ni sum bha zhes sogs zhal bzhi ba'i sngags brjod cing*/ phyogs bzhi dang rang la gtor nas sel gol g.yon skor gyis gdab ste/ sngags tshan bzhi bo shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhir ro ma bzhin brjod pa'i rjes su/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i gzhi khor yug thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ gur gyi 'og ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i bla re ste/ thams cad kyang rdo rje 'bar ba'i rang bzhin bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i me 'jig dus kyi me lta bus bskor bar gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla gdan la rdor sems kyi ngo bo oṃ ha dkar bo zhes sogs go cha drug bkod nas/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod cing g.yon pa la gsang gtor byas la lag pa mnye bar bya'o/ /de nas g.yon pa'i sor mo lnga la me tog bzhag pa 'am/ yang na nang mchod kyi thig le re byas la/ g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams bsdus pa'i mthe bong la zla gdan/ gzhan bzhi dang sor mo lnga bsdus pa'i sen mo rnams la nyi ma'i gdan re re/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du mthe bong la rdor sems kyi ngo bo oṃ ha dkar bo/ /mdzub mo la rnam snang gi ngo bo na ma hi ser bo/ /gung mo la pad+ma gar dbang gi ngo bo swā hā hu dmar bo/ /srin lag la dpal he ru ka'i ngo bo bo ṣa ṭa he nag po/ /mthe'u chung la rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo bo hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser/ sen mo rnams la rta mchog gi ngo bo phaṭa haṃ ljang ku

rnams bsams la/ g.yon pa'i mthil du pad+ma dmar ba 'dab ma lnga ba'i lte bar/ nyi ma la rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ baṃ dmar bo/ /shar gyi 'dab mar nyi ma la gshin rje ma'i ngo bo haṃ yoṃ sngon po/ dbang ldan du zla ba la rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo hriṃ moṃ dkar bo/ byang du nyi ma la bskyod byed ma'i ngo bo hriṃ hriṃ ser bo/ nub tu nyi ma la skrag byed ma'i ngo bo hūṃ hūṃ ljang ku/ lho'i 'dab mar nyi ma la gtum byed ma'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur bar bsam pa 'am/ yang na sngags de rnams las lha so sor bsgom pa'am/ sngags de rnams las rdo rje sogs phyag mtshan bcu gnyis yongs su gyur pa las lha rnams cho ga gsum gyis bskyed pa'am/ yang na gnas so sor lha rnams dkrong bskyed bya'o/ /de yang yab rnams la yum gyis 'khyud pa dang*/ yum rnams par rang rang gi yab kyis 'khyud pa 'am/ yang na yab yum rkyang ba bskyed pa rnams gang rung bya'o/ /go cha dgod pa la yang de bzhin du bya'o/ / lag pa'i pol la me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar/ go cha'i sngags sam lha bcu gnyis gsal bar gyur/ yang na 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs bsam mo/ / lag pa'i sa'i khams ni ltung byed ma/ chu'i khams ni gsod byed ma/ me'i khams ni 'gugs byed ma/ rlung gi khams ni gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ nam mkha'i khams ni pad+ma'i dra ba can gyi ngo bor gyur par bsams nas/ lag par gnas pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge rnams la lag pa g.yas pas khu ba'i rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa blangs nas lag pa g.yon pa'i phyin nang kun tu/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ brjod cing lan gsum du byug la/ de bzhin du chang gis kyang byug ste/ lag pa dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'khor lo gsum gyi ngo bor gyur bar bsam pa 'am/ yang na 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs su mos par bya'o/ /de nas phyogs gtsang ma khru gang la sogs ji tsam 'tsham pa'i rgyab phyi dor legs par byas la/

der lag pa g.yon pa gtad pa 'am bzhag la/ zhal bzhi ba'i sngags brjod/ de nas bdud rtsi ril bu dri zhim po dang sbyar ba'am/ bdud rtsi lnga gang rnyed pa rnams na mchod dang ba byung lnga dang sbyar la g.yon skor du khyo ma med par gru bzhi'i rnam par byugs la/ de'i dbus su lag pa g.yon pa bzhag ste/ pu dza/ o a/ go ra/ de ma/ kā o/ tri ko ka la/ ka hi/ pre gṛ/ sau su/ na si/ ma ku oṃ pīthā/ u ba pī thā/ k+ṣe tra/ u pa k+ṣe tra/ ts+tshan do ha/ u pa ts+tshan do ha/ me la ka /u pa me la ka /sh+ma shā ni/ u pa sh+ma shā ne / zhes brjod nas/ sa gzhi bde stong dbyer med kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i gnas dang*/ nye ba'i gnas la sogs pa sa dang po la sogs pa'i rang zhin du gyur par mos la/ de nas lha gnas mi 'chol kha'i phyir du/ rtsa thig tshun chad ji tsam 'tsham pa'i thig btab la/ gtso bo yab yum dang snying bo'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i gnas su/ dri bzang bos thig le gru bzhi ba re dang*/ lha gzhan rnams kyi gnas su zlum po re bya ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod cing*/ me tog gi tshom bu re dgod do/ /tshom bu de dag ltar bsgom pa ma yin gyi/ phyis lha la me tog 'bul ba'i tshe gnas nges par bya ba'i phyir yin no/ /de nas thod pa la sogs pa'i nang du/ nas dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ me tog dkar bo dang*/ rtswa ku sha dang*/ til dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ 'bras yos dang*/ dri bzang btab pa'i chu bzhi dang*/ nyer spyod mo dang bcas pa la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams/ 'bru gsum dang*/ yi ge bdun pa dang las thams cad pa brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ lan bdun gyis sngags la/ rang gi g.yon ngos snod gsum du chu bzhi/ de'i mdun du bzed zhal gsum dang bcas pa bzhag/me tog la sogs pa mdun bskyed kyi g.yon nas 'bul ba'i rim pa bzhin du bsham/ rang gis mdun du rdor dril/ g.yas su cang te'u/ g.yon du thod pa chang gis bkang ba rnams bsham mo/ / gtor ma 'byor na/

sha dang nya sha dang sgog pa dang*/ btsong la sogs pa dang bcas pa'am/ ma 'byor ji ltar rnyed pa bsham mo/ /de nas 'bru gsum dang*/ oṃ sum+bha ni zhes sogs brjod cing nang mchod gtor ma mchod sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mdun bskyaid sgrub pa ni/ sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs stong ba'i ngang las skad cig gis rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu g.yas g.yon gnyis su rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor kha dog dmar bo dbyibs gru gsum pa zhes pa nas lcogs brgyad kyi nye bar mdzes pa/ zhes sa bon med par skad cig gis bskyed/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i steng gi lte bar lte ba dang*/ tshad mnyam pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba nas ge sar ser ba/ de'i steng du dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge rnams me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin du snang ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ rang gi snying ka nas hūm̐ yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can 'phros ba sna bug g.yas pa nas 'thon te/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gnas par gyur par bsams la/ hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa sbyan drangs/ hūm̐ la thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shung+nghaḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shung+ngho3haṃ/ zhes skad cig ma'i sngags gsum brjod nas/ hūm̐ zla ba dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dus gcig tu grub pa ni/ mngon byang lnga bskyed bsdus pa'o/ / de yang khang ba brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi ba sgo bzhi ba zhes pa nas 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi dpral bar rdo rje'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa

zhes sgrub thabs ltar gsal gdab/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba la rdor sems kyi ngo bo oṃ ha dkar bo zhes pa nas phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur ces go cha bgo/ phaiṃ ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi zhes pa nas don grub kyis dbu brgyan bar gyur ces ye shes pa gzhug cing dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams mdun bskyed ltar bya/ bsdu na go cha dang dbu rgyan rang chas su grub par bsam de nas rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur bar bsams la/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ / zhes sogs mdun bskyed kyis skabs ltar/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo rig ma bcu drug gdugs rgyal mtshan bla re rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa yang dbul/ de nas lag pa g.yon pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gtso bo yab yum gnyis la me tog dbul/ kha cig spyir me tog dbul zhes gsung ngo*/ /de nas gtso bo yab yum gyi snying bo dang*/ nye snying gis me tog dbul lo/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma nas bzung ste/ gshin rje 'joms ma'i bar la phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor gyis lha rang rang gi gnas su/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ ya ma ma thā ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i bar lha rang rang gi sngags kyis me tog dbul lo/ /de nas lag pa la bkod pa'i lha rnams la/ oṃ ha zhes sogs brjod cing lha rang rang gi gnas su lag pa g.yas pas me tog dbul lo/ /lag pa'i bol la lha rdzogs par bkod pa yin na/ oṃ hūm̐ baṃ ṛṃ ṝṃ l̥ṃ l̥̄ṃ kaṃ khaṃ zhes pa nas shaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i bar gyi ma yig dor ba rnams brjod la me tog dbul/ de nas lag pa g.yon pas me tog bzung rkang brgyad kyi sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su me tog dor la/

g.yon pa'i dgur phyag rgya bcas nas g.yas g.yon gyi dpung mgor pad kor byas te/ mgo bor thal mo sbyar nas 'dud pa'i tshul byas pas/ lag pa'i lha'i 'khor lo bdag nyid lag gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas sngags mchod/ bstod pa/ rgyun bshags thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom bzung*/ gtor 'bul/ bzlas pa/ dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ 'dod gsol/ smon lam rnams bya'o/ /de nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ yo ga shung+nghaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shung+ngho3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing rnam lnga 'dod pa'i phyogs su bskor ba byas la/ mthar 'khyud pa'i tshul byas nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes se gol gdab cing*/ srin lag gis maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu la reg la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams zhu nas hūm̐ du gyur te/ rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig la thim par gyur bar bsam/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi tshom bu rnams dbus su bsdus nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bzlas pa'i chu gtsang mas ri mo rnams bsubs la rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /de nas shis brjod rgyas bsdus ci rigs byas te me tog gi char dbab bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa lag mchod ni/ zas la longs spyod ba'i tshe spyi dang*/ khyad par du tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs dang*/ yar ngo dang mar ngo'i tshes bcu la lag mchod byed par gsungs bas de'i tshul ni/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas me tog la sogs pa'i phyi mchod dang*/ sha chang sogs gong bu dang*/ khu ba'i rdzas ci 'byor ba rnams byin gyis brlab/ khyad par sha chang sogs kyi bza' btung rnams gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs te mdun du bzhag la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod/

oṃ āḥ hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ g.yon pa la bsang gtor byas la/ lag pa mnye par bya'o zhes pa nas/ lag pa dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'khor lo gsum gyi lha'i ngo bor gyur bar bsam/ yang na 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs su mos par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar sngar lag pa sbyang ba'i skabs ltar byas pa'i rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ rkang brgyad kyi sngags brjod cing*/ khu ba'i rdzas thug pa dang*/ zho la sogs pa lag pa g.yas pas g.yon pa'i steng du bzhag la dbul/ de bzhin du sha dang zan la sogs pa gong bu'i rdzas rnams kyang*/ lag pa'i lha yang dbul/ de nas/ oṃ ha oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs go cha'i sngags la 'bru gsum btags pa brjod la chang gis kyang mchod do/ /de nas yab kyi go cha la g.yas skor dang*/ yum gyi go cha la g.yon skor dang*/ 'khor lo'i lha la phyogs g.yon dang*/ mtshams g.yas skor gyis phul nas/ nyer spyod dang rig ma bcu drug gis kyang mchod la/ rkang ba brgyad pa sogs kyis bstod nas lhag chad kyi nyes pa zhi ba'i phyir du he ru ka'i yig brgya brjod la/ tshogs dang 'brel na de byin gyis brlab pa'i don dang*/ skabs gzhan yin na skabs dang mthun par/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab bo/ /lag pa la mchod pa'i rdzas de rnams phyed ni tshogs kyi bza' btung ngam/ rang za ba'i bza' btung la bsre zhing*/ phyed ni snod gzhan zhig tu bcug ste bzhag par bya'o/ /phyi ma ltar byas na longs spyod 'phel ba'i rten 'brel yod par bla ma kha cig bzhed do/ /de nas lag pa g.yon pa la gos pa'i rdzas rnams g.yas pas bsdus te g.yon pa'i lag mthil du bzhag /de nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bzung nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes rim pa bzhin snying ka dang*/ lce dang*/ mgo bor byugs te pad kor byas nas mgo bor bzhag la/ oṃ yo ga shud dhāḥ zhes sogs brjod pas lag pa'i lha rnams spyi bo nas zhugs te/

bdag nyid la gzhug par bya'o/ /lag pa la gos pa'i rdzas lhag ma rnams lag pa phan tshun mnyes la mgo dang*/ yan lag rnams la byugs nas srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro zhes gsung ngo*/ /de rnams ni gzhung nas bshad pa ltar phyi rol mchod pa sger du byed pa'i dbang du btang la/ lag mchod dang sbrel na gong gi lag pa'i 'khor lo bdag nyid la gzhug par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i skabs der lha gzhug tu mi rung bas khyad par shes par bya'o/ / da lta mdun bskyed sgrub tshul spyi ltar byas nas/ phyi rol lag mchod dang bcas pa mdzad pa'i srol 'dug pa ltar byas na/ gong gi lha gnas mi 'chol ba'i phyir du thig btab ste thig le dang*/ der tshom bu 'god pa'i skor rnams cung mi 'brel yang*/ 'bul rgyu'i me tog gi tshom bu rnams stegs kyi khar lha gnas so so dang mthun par 'god du rung snyam ste brtag /phyi mchod kyi dkyil 'khor zur du bsgrubs pa min par rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i skabs lha gshegs gsol byed du mi rung bas yo ga shung+nghaḥ zhes sogs brjod mi dgos te khyad par shes par bya'o// //zhes bde mchog lū hi ba'i bum bskyed mdun bskyed lag mchod dang bcas pa la bstod pa dang shis brjod mdor bsdus pa gnyis rang gi bsnan te bris pa 'di ni/ dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i gong so'i dge slong blo bzang brtson 'grus kyis dad pas 'di rnams par du bsgrubs pa'i tshe bskul ba ltar shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub kyis bsgrigs pa'o// //kra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/bde mchog lū hi pa'i bum bskyed mdun bskyed lag mchod dang bcas pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 84-- PAGE 83-- PAGE 59-
